en.На принтере Bambu Lab:\n• IP-адрес и код:
On the Bambu Lab printer:
• IP address and access code: Settings → WLAN (on A1/P1: Settings → Network).
• Serial number: Settings → Device (or the label on the case).
• Turn on LAN Only. On 2025 firmware also turn on Developer Mode so third-party apps can control the printer.
The phone and the printer must be on the same Wi-Fi network. The Chinese and global versions connect the same way.
